learning_model_payload.name: local_assistant
learning_model_payload.description: Private assistant model service used by Painel Amanaje.

code_model_payload.name: local_assistant_prompt_context
code_model_payload.description: Prompt templates, context-pack rules, and alignment contracts for the private assistant.

alignment_contracts.output_alignment: Every response must validate as WorkflowDraft and include the required workflow outputs.
alignment_contracts.safety_alignment: Generated code must pass assistant_safety.py before approval or execution.
alignment_contracts.registry_alignment: Registry drafts must map to the supported manual registry object payloads.
alignment_contracts.dependency_alignment: Drafted code must stay inside allowed imports, dependencies, and artifact formats.
alignment_contracts.mlflow_alignment: Drafts, evals, context packs, prompt versions, and model versions must be traceable.

prompt_templates.dataset_generation: Draft safe Python code that creates synthetic tabular data and exposes csv_text plus dataset metadata. Use only allowed dependencies, align names with trusted internal references, and never write files.
prompt_templates.model_generation: Draft safe Python code that creates a scikit-learn joblib artifact as base64 joblib_bytes plus LearningModel metadata. The artifact is a template, must not train on hidden data, and must match project dependency constraints.
prompt_templates.registry_object: Draft a form-ready registry payload for the selected registry type using internal schema references. Do not create the object; only return metadata.
prompt_templates.feature_operations: Draft visual feature operations that match the selected dataset context and can be previewed before materialization.
prompt_templates.training_run: Draft a reviewed training request that uses existing selected model and dataset identifiers.
prompt_templates.study: Draft an optimization study request using existing project study settings and safe defaults.

draft_quality_rubric.title_quality: Title is specific to the requested artifact or workflow.
draft_quality_rubric.summary_quality: Summary is not generic and explains the generated draft's project fit.
draft_quality_rubric.metadata_quality: Registry metadata and materialized outputs match project schemas.
draft_quality_rubric.risk_quality: Risks and assumptions are concrete enough for user review.
draft_quality_rubric.reference_quality: Internal references are summarized, traceable, and not copied raw into prompts.

alignment_contract_descriptions.dependency_alignment: Drafted code must stay inside allowed imports, dependencies, and artifact formats.
